general_rules: A playing card can carry at most one Enhancement, one Edition and one Seal at the same time.
Applying a new Enhancement or Seal replaces the old one of that type. Editions cannot be overwritten (Aura/Wheel/Hex/Ectoplasm only target edition-less cards).
Jokers can have one Edition plus any number of in-run stickers (Eternal, Perishable, Rental).
Consumables normally have no modifiers; Perkeo can create Negative consumables.
Debuffed cards/jokers lose all modifier effects EXCEPT Negative's +1 slot and Stone's 'no rank/suit'. A debuffed Wild card counts as its printed suit.
Retriggers repeat Enhancement, Edition and Gold Seal payouts, but never re-trigger a Red Seal (Red Seal only ever adds 1 retrigger).
Probabilities written as '1 in N' are 'listed probabilities': Oops! All 6s doubles the numerator per copy (Glass break, Lucky rolls, Wheel of Fortune, The Wheel boss).

enhancements.name: Bonus Card
enhancements.effect: Adds +30 chips when it scores (on top of the card's rank chips).

enhancements.name: Wild Card
enhancements.effect: Counts as every suit at once for hand detection and suit-based effects. Debuffed Wild cards revert to their printed suit. Suit-debuff bosses (The Club/Goad/Head/Window) debuff all Wild cards.

enhancements.name: Glass Card
enhancements.effect: x2 Mult when it scores. After the hand is fully scored, each scored (non-debuffed) Glass card rolls once to shatter (be destroyed).
enhancements.timing: x2 on_scored (each retrigger applies x2 again); break roll once per hand after scoring, retriggers do NOT add rolls

enhancements.name: Steel Card
enhancements.effect: x1.5 Mult while it stays in hand when a hand is played (held-in-hand effect). Gives nothing when played.
enhancements.timing: held_in_hand (each hand played); retriggered by Red Seal and Mime

enhancements.name: Stone Card
enhancements.effect: +50 chips when it scores; has no rank and no suit (cannot help form hands), and is ALWAYS added to the scoring cards when played, even if not part of the poker hand. Underlying rank/suit is kept and restored if the enhancement is replaced.

enhancements.name: Gold Card
enhancements.effect: Gives $3 at end of round if this card is still held in hand (not played). Retriggered by Red Seal and Mime.
enhancements.timing: end_of_round, held_in_hand; money counts toward this round's interest

enhancements.name: Lucky Card
enhancements.effect: When scored, two independent rolls: 1 in 5 for +20 Mult and 1 in 15 for $20. Both can hit; each retrigger rolls again.

editions.name: Foil
editions.timing: playing card: after its enhancement and seal, as part of the card's own trigger (repeated on retrigger). joker: added immediately BEFORE that joker's own independent effect in the joker pass.

editions.name: Holographic
editions.timing: same slot as Foil (before the joker's own effect; on playing cards after enhancement/seal).

editions.name: Polychrome
editions.timing: playing card: last part of the card's own trigger. joker: applied AFTER the joker's own effect and after any Baseball Card bonus aimed at that joker.

editions.name: Negative
editions.effect: +1 Joker slot (on a joker) or +1 consumable slot (on a consumable). No scoring effect. Still counts while debuffed.
editions.notes: Invisible Joker and Ankh copies lose Negative. A Negative joker can be bought even with full slots.

seals.name: Gold Seal
seals.effect: Earn $3 when this card is played and scores. Paid again on every retrigger; $0 if debuffed.
seals.timing: on_scored, part of the card's own trigger (after enhancement, before edition)

seals.name: Red Seal
seals.effect: Retrigger this card 1 extra time. Works both when played-and-scored and for held-in-hand / end-of-round effects (Steel, Gold card, Blue Seal). Not itself retriggered by Mime/Hack/etc.
seals.timing: first retrigger in the queue (before joker retriggers)

seals.name: Blue Seal
seals.effect: If this card is held in hand at end of round, create the Planet card for the last poker hand played this round (needs a free consumable slot). Retriggerable by Red Seal/Mime (extra planets, room permitting).

seals.name: Purple Seal
seals.effect: When this card is discarded, create a random Tarot card (needs a free consumable slot).

stickers.name: Eternal
stickers.effect: Joker cannot be sold or destroyed.
stickers.where: shop jokers and Buffoon pack jokers
stickers.notes: Mutually exclusive with Perishable. Never on jokers created by Judgement/Wraith/Soul/Top-up/Riff-Raff etc. (only shop and packs).

stickers.name: Perishable
stickers.effect: Joker becomes debuffed after 5 rounds (debuff happens at end of the 5th round, before cash-out, so cash-out money jokers effectively pay 4 times).
stickers.where: shop jokers and Buffoon pack jokers
stickers.notes: Eternal/Perishable come from ONE roll: roll > 0.7 -> Eternal (30%), 0.4 < roll <= 0.7 -> Perishable (30%), else neither (40%). A debuffed joker keeps its sell value.

stickers.name: Rental
stickers.effect: Joker's buy price becomes $1, but you lose $3 at the end of every round (charged before the cash-out payout, can push into debt, still charged while debuffed).
stickers.where: shop jokers and Buffoon pack jokers
stickers.notes: Independent roll from Eternal/Perishable; all jokers are compatible.

jokers_shop_and_packs.note: One uniform roll r per joker: Negative if r > 1-0.003; else Polychrome if r > 1-0.006*R; else Holographic if r > 1-0.02*R; else Foil if r > 1-0.04*R; where R = edition rate (1 base, 2 Hone, 4 Glow Up). Negative is not scaled by Hone/Glow Up.

standard_pack_playing_cards.note: Same edition roll with a x2 modifier and Negative excluded. Enhancement 40% (uniform over the 8 enhancements), Seal 20% (uniform over the 4 seals).

illusion_shop_playing_cards.note: Illusion voucher: shop playing cards are Enhanced 40% of the time and get an edition 20% of the time (of which Polychrome 15%, Holographic 35%, Foil 50%). Not affected by Hone/Glow Up. Despite its text, Illusion never adds seals (bug in 1.0.1o).

guaranteed_edition_split.note: Used by Aura and by a successful Wheel of Fortune (no Negative).
